text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,227.95, down 0.63% on the day and 0.81% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 fell 0.81% (119 advancers vs 375 decliners). Bank Nifty slipped 0.38% to 62,038.65, though it remains up 2.05% on the week. Breadth was “healthy” with a score of 69.2; about 68% of stocks stayed above their 20‑day moving average, but only half were above the 200‑day level, indicating mixed momentum.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹5,866.78 cr today and a cumulative ₹28,493.99 cr over five days, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹3,159.9 cr. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 0.85 for Nifty (bullish tilt) and 1.18 for Bank Nifty (slightly bearish). Max‑pain levels sit at 25,050 for Nifty and 60,000 for Bank Nifty, with support walls near 24,000 and 24,000 respectively and resistance walls at 26,000 and 62,000.

Watch the 25,216 S1 level and the 25,353 pivot on Nifty; a break below 24,950 could test the 24,000 put wall. For Bank Nifty, the 61,748 S1 and 62,056 pivot are key – a fall through 60,000 may invite further selling. Keep an eye on global cues such as Fed minutes and crude oil moves, which have been influencing sentiment.
